theme.title: Stars and Surprises
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: The 2005–06 Pistons won a franchise-record 64 games. How many did Detroit's 2003–04 title team win?
questions.note: 54–28, before the defense-first Pistons won the title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: finishing second in the Central Division with a 54–28 record

funFacts.text: Detroit made Darko Miličić its top pick in 2003 but used him only as a reserve.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They selected Darko Miličić as their top pick but only used him as a reserve

funFacts.text: Larry Brown arrived as head coach after Detroit reached the Eastern Conference finals the year before.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: After their first trip to the Conference Finals since 1991, the Pistons hired Larry Brown as head coach.

funFacts.text: Detroit's home arena for the 2004 Finals was The Palace of Auburn Hills, in Auburn Hills, Michigan.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Palace of Auburn Hills, Auburn Hills, Michigan

questions.prompt: What share of Wilt Chamberlain's 100 points came from free throws? Nearest whole percent.
questions.context: Wilt Chamberlain · Warriors vs Knicks · March 2, 1962
questions.note: 28%: he made 28 of 32 free throws, far better than his roughly 50% career rate.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: by scoring 100 points for the Philadelphia Warriors in a 169–147 win over the New York Knicks on March 2, 1962

funFacts.text: Wilt had switched to shooting his free throws underhanded that season, on his coach's advice.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He had started shooting free throws underhanded that season per McGuire's suggestion.

funFacts.text: His free-throw accuracy that night was far better than his roughly 50% career rate.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the latter a far better rate than his roughly 50% career average.

funFacts.text: The game was played at Hershey Sports Arena, an old gym originally built for ice hockey.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The game was played at Hershey Sports Arena, an old, drafty gym originally built for ice hockey.

questions.prompt: Robert Horry hit the game-winner in Game 5 of the 2005 Finals. How many points did he score off the bench?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Horry went 5 for 6 from beyond the arc, including the game-winner, and scored 21 points coming off the bench.

funFacts.text: Rasheed Wallace left Horry open when he doubled Manu Ginóbili, setting up the decisive shot.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Rasheed Wallace had left Horry to double-team Ginobili

funFacts.text: Horry did not score until the very end of the third quarter before taking over late.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He hadn't scored a point until the final play of the 3rd quarter

funFacts.text: The shot added to Horry's reputation for late-game heroics, already established with the Lakers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Horry was already famous for nailing last-second shots in the playoffs

questions.prompt: Bars: other Finals MVPs' averages. What did Michael Jordan average against Phoenix in the 1993 Finals?
questions.context: 1993 NBA Finals · six games vs Phoenix
questions.note: 41.0, a Finals record, as Chicago completed its first three-peat.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: averaged a Finals-record 41.0 PPG during the six-game series

funFacts.text: The Suns traded Jeff Hornacek, Tim Perry and Andrew Lang to Philadelphia for Charles Barkley.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: acquiring Charles Barkley from the Philadelphia 76ers in exchange for Jeff Hornacek, Tim Perry, and Andrew Lang

funFacts.text: Phoenix forced a rare triple-overtime Game 3, then won it at Chicago Stadium.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Phoenix Suns won Game 3 in triple overtime, 129–121

funFacts.text: Scottie Pippen also filled the box score with over nine rebounds and seven assists per game.

questions.prompt: Bars: other huge regular-season scoring nights. How many did James Harden score at Madison Square Garden in January 2019?
questions.context: James Harden · Houston Rockets at Knicks · January 2019

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On January 23, Harden scored a career-high 61 points to go with 15 rebounds in a 114–110 win over the New York Knicks
